properties: image decoding and BioCLIP encoding end before dynamic pool scoring begins

image_batch_contract.capacity_formula: floor((target_driver_memory_fraction * recommended_max_bytes - driver_allocated_bytes) / estimated_incremental_bytes_per_image), bounded by configured minimum, current and maximum batch sizes
properties: every optional allocator snapshot records current, driver and recommended maximum bytes
a recognized memory error retries only the still-uncommitted failed slice at a bounded smaller size
minimum-size memory errors and all non-memory errors propagate
absence of a memory probe uses a labeled deterministic fixed-batch path
embedding identities and vector values are unchanged by scheduling

hard_limits: unique immutable pool matrices per batch
unique immutable Float32 pool-matrix bytes per batch
properties: one matrix signature contributes bytes once within a batch even when referenced by multiple work items
one work item that exceeds a matrix or byte ceiling fails closed
execution order is deterministic and groups shared route, visual-input, prototype and pool-matrix identities
canonical result order is independent of execution scheduling
validation recomputes policy, batches, metrics, fingerprints and fusion/ranking structure without repeating matrix scoring
metrics distinguish within-batch reuse from cross-batch matrix reloads
